english.meaning: after 起, shows that something starts or takes effect once it begins, as in 衰起上來 (once things go bad)
english.note: Used in patterns like 計起上來 (when you work it out). This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: When things go bad, they go really bad—you have to tread carefully.
exampleSentences.traditional: 衰起上來就會好衰（），步步為營啊都話要。
